tier2.diagnosis: OAuth refresh token expired or revoked. External Google/OAuth consent flow required. AI self-healing cannot repair OAuth tokens.

action.instructions:
1. Run token renewal locally: npm run blogger-token
2. Complete the OAuth consent flow in the browser that opens.
3. Re-run: npm run check:syndication -- --write
Note: AI self-healing cannot create a new valid OAuth refresh token. This requires external user consent.
